title: Teitoku no Ketsudan III
overview:
An evolution built on popular demand. War SLG now reaches the highest level.

As Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Japanese Navy's Combined Fleet or Commander-in-Chief of the U.S. Pacific Fleet, you fight to achieve your operational objectives. With data more detailed than the previous game and three-dimensional battles that unfold on sea and in the air, the game content is deep, with heightened tactical elements. Of course, commands that beginners can enjoy are also provided. Who will survive the fierce battles and seize supremacy over the Pacific?

- The key to naval warfare: the "decisive fleet battle." Fought on sea and in the air, you can enjoy truly powerful "3D battles."
- The number of ships is 1.4 times that of the previous game. Aircraft are a full 2 times the previous game, and new weapons have been added too. Each military figure also has a profile, and the data is even more detailed.
- You can refit ships and design new ships and new aircraft. Combining them with existing ones broadens your tactical range and lets you carry out a variety of operations.
- Introduces "operations conferences" where your fleet staff give you advice. Receiving advice helps you understand your situation and make appropriate decisions.
- Opening and ending portrayed in movies.
- 1 campaign scenario and 6 short scenarios.
- 24 BGM tracks in all (composed and arranged by Bob Sakuma).

それは、熱望に基づく進化。
――ウォーSLGは今、至高の域へ。

あなたは日本海軍連合艦隊司令長官、またはアメリカ海軍太平洋艦隊司令長官として、作戦目標の達成をめざし戦います。前作を上回る詳細なデータや、海上・空で展開する立体的な戦闘など、戦術の要素を高めた奥深いゲーム内容になっています。もちろん初心者の方にも楽しめるコマンドも用意しました。激戦をくぐり抜け、太平洋の覇権を手にするのは果たして誰でしょうか。

●海戦の要“艦隊決戦”。海上・空で繰り広げられ、まさに迫力ある「立体バトル」が満喫できる。
●登場艦船数は前作の1.4倍。航空機も実に前作の2倍となり、新兵器も増加。また登場軍人にはそれぞれのプロフィールがつき、データも一段と緻密に。
●艦船の改装や、新型艦船・新型航空機の設計も可能。既存のものと組み合わせて使えば戦術の幅も広がり、多彩な作戦を遂行することもできる。
●艦隊参謀が助言を与えてくれる「作戦会議」を導入。助言を得ることで自分の置かれた状況が理解でき、適切な判断を下す手助けに。
●ムービーで描かれるオープニング、エンディング。
●キャンペーンシナリオ1本、ショートシナリオ6本。
●BGMは全24曲（作・編曲／ボブ佐久間）。
